privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: What a hotel and le-hoetel keep about you, why, and how to take it back.

collect.title: What is collected
collect.body: Your name, phone number and language, because the hotel needs them to welcome you. Your birthday and email only if you add them. Nothing else without a clear yes: never your location, ID or passport number, or payment card.

use.title: Why
use.body: So the hotel can welcome you, send a birthday wish, ask how your stay went, and answer you if something was wrong.

consent.title: Messages and your yes
consent.body: Offers and news come by WhatsApp or email only if you switched that channel on. We record when, where and with which wording you said yes. Every message has a link to stop, and replying STOP on WhatsApp works too.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Ask the hotel for a copy of your data or for its deletion at any time. Deletion is complete. You can also take your yes back with the link in any message. Tunisian law on personal data protection applies (Organic Law 2004-63).

keep.title: Who sees it and for how long
keep.body: Only the staff of the hotel you signed up at. Hotels never see each other's guests. Data is kept while the hotel uses le-hoetel and is deleted when you ask or when the hotel leaves.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: The simple rules for hotels using le-hoetel.

service.title: The service
service.body: le-hoetel helps a hotel collect guests with their consent, send messages they agreed to, and hear from unhappy guests early. It is in pilot: features and prices can change.

duties.title: What a hotel promises
duties.body: To collect only guests who said yes, to honour every stop request, never to send spam, and to answer export and delete requests.

pilot.title: Pilot and price
pilot.body: The pilot is free for 60 to 90 days. Nothing is charged without a written agreement. Prices shown during the pilot are not final.

data.title: Your data
data.body: The hotel owns its guest list and can export or delete it at any time. We do not sell or share it.

end.title: Ending
end.body: Either side can stop at any time. When it ends the hotel can take its data and we delete the rest.
